description:
pkix-path/src/lib.rs lines 169-215: The Display impl for Error uses the type name explicitly in every match arm:
  Error::SignatureInvalid { index } => ...
  Error::ValidityPeriod { index } => ...
  ... (all 15 variants)

Clippy (nursery/pedantic) flags this as 'unnecessary structure name repetition — use the applicable keyword: Self'. Changing Error:: to Self:: in match arms inside impl Error blocks is the idiomatic Rust style for 2018+ edition code. It also means a type rename does not require updating every arm.

This affects pkix-path/src/lib.rs Display impl (line 169), std::error::Error impl (line 218), and the From<der::Error> impl (line 244).

Same pattern exists in pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs Error::Display (line 93).
title: Error::Display uses Error:: prefix instead of Self:: in match arms
